run_encoder_analysis_cli: run the encoder analysis tool on a directory with --langs en,fr to compute cross-lingual retrieval accuracy
compute_dist_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between source and target sentence embeddings and return top-k nearest neighbors
load_embeddings_from_disk: load sentence embeddings and texts from binary shard files and sentence files for multiple languages
compute_accuracy_cross_lingual: compute top-1 and top-5 cross-lingual sentence retrieval accuracy across all language pairs and write results
review_compute_dist_neighbors: review the compute_dist function to understand how it normalizes embeddings and finds nearest neighbors
